symptom: `check -p` 4-7x slower than v0.24.0 on `create or modify` of microflows the project already holds, with a per-statement cost that grows with the project (25 re-declared flows in a 574-unit blank 11.14 app: 3 s -> 23 s; ~14x on a 3,700-unit app). New flows barely affected; `exec` pays it too, through its preflight. Still present after the lazy kind listing of #1050
cause: The verdict pass (decideFlowModify, ako/mxcli#876) and the reference pass look flows up by name per statement — ListMicroflows, GetMicroflow, GetRawUnitByName — and every lookup (1) re-read every microflow file from mprcontents/, because the reader's content cache (EnableContentCache) had no caller, and (2) fully decoded every microflow (codec Decode + microflowFromGen) to pick one by name or ID; GetRawUnitByName bson.Unmarshal'd every candidate into a map just to compare Name. ~9 such lookups per statement = statements x microflows reads and decodes (57,290 file opens for 25 statements)
file: `modelsdk/mpr/reader_units.go` (Reader.CacheUnitReads: scoped, nesting, copy-on-return) via `mdl/executor/exec_context.go` ExecContext.CacheUnitReads in the Executor check entry points and around exec's decideFlowModify; `modelsdk/mprread/generic.go` (ListUnitsWithContainerWhere, ListUnitHeaders, HasName/HasID) behind backend ListMicroflowsNamed / ListMicroflowHeaders / GetMicroflow, used through executor microflowsNamed / microflowHeaders (helpers.go) by buildMicroflowFromStmt, loadAlterFlow, describeMicroflowMode, getMicroflowNames, buildMicroflowQualifiedNames; `modelsdk/mpr/reader_raw.go` (rawUnitName)
insight: **Two costs hid behind one symptom, and each fix alone looked like the answer.** A cold-cache run (46 s wall vs 7 s user) pointed at I/O: `strace -f -c` and an openat histogram showed every unit file read ~529 times, and a temporary stack dump per os.ReadFile named the callers. Caching the reads cut that run to 2.3 s — but re-measured warm against v0.24.0 on the same machine it was still 2-4x slower, and a CPU profile then showed ListMicroflows decoding every flow per lookup (70%). **Benchmark against the baseline binary on the same machine, warm, before declaring a perf fix done** (build the old tag in a scratch worktree; `make sync-all` first or the embed fails). The read cache is scoped to read-only passes, not per connection, so a long session never serves bytes Studio Pro has rewritten; a decoded-element cache was rejected because gen elements could alias into what callers mutate — filtering on raw Name/$ID before decoding has no shared state. Guards: unit-file reads per pass on PedApp with the uncached pass as control (2,928 vs 381 units), and the narrow lookups agree with the filtered full listing (stubbed filter: 19 mismatches)
